ashley: Heads-up — sketching a phased integration for FlashAttention v2/v3 using a hybrid selector rather than a global flip. Goal: avoid broad perf regressions while getting v3 wins for short-context workloads. Outline below, want quick feedback by EOD. :eyes:

ashley: Selector rules (rough):
```
- if seq_len <= 128 -> flashv3
- if 128 < seq_len <= 512 -> flashv3 unless kv_hit_rate > 0.8 -> flashv2
- if seq_len > 512 -> paged-attn or fused-fallback
- if memory_pressure or kv_evictions rising -> fallback to paged/fused
```

ashley: Proposed feature flag: `flash.hybrid_selector` with staged rollout (1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%) and telemetry gating. Metrics to gate on: p95 latency delta, error rate, kernel-fallback-rate, kv_eviction_rate, tokens_per_second.

ken: Quick profiling notes from yesterday's perf job (llama-2-7b, batch=8, mixed seq distribution):
- seq<=64: flashv3 median latency -12%, p95 -8% (win).
- seq=128..512: flashv3 median -6% but p99 shows +15% tail in micro-batch boundary cases (repro with aligned KV hits).
- long-context (>1024): flashv3 uses more transient memory, paged-attn still wins for throughput.

ken: Repro snippet that shows tail blip locally:
```bash
python perf_probe.py --model llama-2-7b --seq-profile default-mix --kernel flashv3 --batch 8 --kv-preload 80
# tail samples spike ~1.3-1.6x at p99 in ~30% of runs
```

maria: For rollout gating, propose automated rollback rules in the deployment controller:
- rollback if p95 latency increases by >8% for 15m window
- rollback if 5xx rate >0.3% over 10m
- rollback if kernel-fallback-rate >2% (indicates selector misprediction)
- Manual hold if kv_eviction_rate increases >10% vs baseline

maria: Staged traffic buckets: 1%(non-prod shaped), 5%(prod low-traffic orgs), 25%(slow ramp), 100%. Each stage stays at least 2 hours and must pass gating.

olga: KV cache behavior concerns: when flashv3 wins on short seq but keeps hot KV in GPU, we see eviction churn when other requests with long context hit the same GPU. Two mitigations: prefer v2 for high-kv-hit sessions OR add a 'kv_isolated' routing hint so selectors avoid mixing long-hot sessions on same worker.

olga: Also suggest instrumentation: kv_cache_hit_rate per-token and kv_eviction_count per-minute in the kernel span. We need to correlate evictions -> p95 jumps.

ashley: Good point. We'll add a 'kv_hint' to the request meta that can be >0.8/0.5/0 to guide the selector. Example: `meta.kv_hint=high` -> prefer v2.

dave: Telemetry ask: please add kernel_name, selector_choice, seq_len_bucket, kv_hint, kv_hit_rate to traces and metrics. That will make it easy to build a selector-accuracy dashboard and detect misroutes. Proposed tag names: `kernel`, `selector.v`, `seq_bucket`, `kv_hint`, `kv_hit_pct`.

sre-bot: ALERT POLICY DRAFT:
- p95_latency_delta > 10% (15m) -> paged blackout + paging notif to #incidents
- kernel_fallback_rate > 3% (10m) -> auto-rollforward disable + paging
- kv_eviction_rate > 12% (5m) -> route isolation flag enabled

ashley: Next steps/action items:
- ken: tune and re-run perf job with mixed-kv preload scenarios and attach flamegraphs (owner: ken, due TOMORROW)
- olga: prototype `kv_hint` propagation + per-worker isolation heuristics (owner: olga, PR by EOW)
- maria: implement staged rollout plan + rollback rules in deploy controller (owner: maria, draft today)
- dave: add telemetry fields to traces and create initial selector dashboard (owner: dave, stub dashboard by EOD)

ashley: If no objections, I'll enable `flash.hybrid_selector` at 1% tomorrow morning and start the canary. Please thumbs-up or call out blockers. :thumbsup:

ken: thumbs-up. will attach results. :thumbsup:

olga: :thumbsup: one note — add a quick smoke test that stresses KV eviction path before each stage.

maria: ack, adding smoke test to rollout job.

ashley: Thanks everyone — will post a follow-up with the canary link and dashboard once live. :rocket:
